newsitem.title: UK: Tesco targets young mothers - paper.
newsitem.headline: Tesco targets young mothers - paper.

text.p: Food retail group Tesco Plc plans to make the first supermarket foray into the mail order catalogue business on Tuesday, said the Independent newspaper.
The catalogue will offer maternity clothing and other nursery items in an extension of Tesco's BabyClub scheme launched in January.

The newspaper quoted Tesco's commercial director Simon Unwins as saying the market was a major growth area. The company was trying to regain market share lost to children's wear retailer Mothercare, he added.
